error_network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and the server address in Settings.
無法連線到伺服器。請檢查網路連線，以及設定中的伺服器位址。
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
sign_in_to_organize_body: Create courts, manage players, and run roll call from your phone.
在手機上建立場次、管理球友並進行點名。
server_url_help: The website address of your Badminton Court Control Panel deployment, e.g. https://courts.example.com
你的羽球場控面板網站位址，例如 https://courts.example.com
server_change_signs_out: Changing the server signs you out.
變更伺服器會將你登出。
app_language_help: Uses your device language. Change it in system settings.
跟隨裝置語言，可在系統設定中變更。
signed_in_devices_body: Sign out devices you no longer use.
no_devices: No other devices are signed in.
沒有其他已登入的裝置。
optional_coordinates_help: Optional. Used for the map link on the court page.
選填，用於場次頁面的地圖連結。
unsaved_changes: 要捨棄未儲存的變更嗎？
end_roll_call_confirm: Reopen registration and editing for this court?
確定要重新開放此場次的報名與編輯嗎？
verification_failed: Verification could not load. Check the server address and try again.
無法載入驗證，請確認伺服器位址後再試一次。
account_hub_body: Manage your profile, security, and app preferences.
管理個人資料、安全性與 App 偏好設定。
guest_body: Join courts without an account. Sign in to organize your own events.
不需帳號即可報名場次；登入後可主辦自己的活動。
admin_courts_body: 包含已封存與已過期的場次。
admin_users_body: Roles, bans, archives, and temporary passwords.
角色、停權、封存與臨時密碼。
user_meta: %1$d 個場次 · 登入失敗 %2$d 次
remember_name: Your username is remembered on this device; your PIN never is.
此裝置會記住你的名稱，但不會儲存 PIN 碼。
temporary_password_banner: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
你使用臨時密碼登入，請設定新密碼以繼續。
empty_my_courts: You haven't created any courts yet.
你還沒有建立任何場次。
empty_my_courts_body: Create your first court and share the link with players.
建立第一個場次，並將連結分享給球友。
no_results_filtered: 沒有符合篩選條件的場次。
remark_placeholder_short: 集合方式或其他注意事項
court_full_waitlist_hint: Full — new players join the waiting list.
已額滿，新報名者將加入候補名單。
notification_channel_courts_body: Event information or member list changes for courts you follow.
你追蹤的場次資訊或球友名單變更。
push_notifications_blocked: Notifications are blocked for this app. Turn them on in system settings.
此 App 的通知已被封鎖，請在系統設定中開啟。
owner_notifications_body: Get a notification on this device when players join or leave this court, or an administrator changes it. Changes you make yourself don't notify you.
球友報名或退出此場次，或管理員修改此場次時，在這台裝置上通知你。你自己做的修改不會通知。
join_notify_prompt_body: Get a notification when this court changes, such as a new time or players joining or leaving.
場次有異動時通知你，例如時間變更，或有球友報名或退出。
leave_notify_prompt_title: 要停止追蹤這個場次嗎？
leave_notify_prompt_body: You left this court. Turn off its notifications on this device?
你已退出此場次。要關閉這台裝置上此場次的通知嗎？
messages_empty: No messages yet. Ask a question or leave a note for other players.
目前尚無留言，歡迎提問或留言給其他球友。
message_placeholder: Ask about the event or leave a note for other players…
詢問活動相關問題，或留言給其他球友…
message_delete_confirm: 確定要刪除這則留言嗎？
message_delete_thread_confirm: Delete this message and all of its replies?
確定要刪除這則留言及其所有回覆嗎？
message_join_required: Only players who joined this court can post. Use the nickname and PIN you joined with.
只有已加入此場次的球友可以留言，請使用加入時的暱稱與 PIN 碼。
message_notify_hint: Turn on notifications for this court to be told when someone replies to you.
開啟此場次的通知，即可在有人回覆你時收到通知。
message_closed: This event is archived, so new messages are closed.
此場次已封存，暫停新增留言。
